static_traits.name: Su Kaiwen
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; have not received psychotherapy before; no similar running- or exercise-related problems before

basic_info.main_problem: I noticed my pace was slower than usual on my last run, which made me feel I should just stop running altogether. This urge to stop running only appeared after that run. I think Work stress and poor nutrition may have contributed to this feeling. As the problem developed, I started doubting my abilities, even considering giving up running entirely. These thoughts appear every time I try to run, affecting my motivation to exercise. I tried pushing harder while running, but it only made me more Depressed.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these negative thoughts about running are affecting my overall well-being and fitness goals, so I have come to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Once completed a 10K race and felt great afterward, proud of myself. At the time I kept regular training, ate Good, and was full of confidence in my abilities; these factors together led to Good performance and a positive experience.

core_beliefs: I have lost my ability as a competent runner

special_situations.event: Running at a slower pace than usual last time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot run as fast as before, it proves I am not good enough or have no ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to train harder in subsequent runs to make up for performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as before; might as well not run

special_situations.event: Running during a period of Work Increased stress and irregular diet, performance declining
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Truly capable people should maintain peak performance even in poor form; otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores rest and nutrition and keeps intensifying training to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Stress and diet ruined me; I may no longer be a qualified runner

special_situations.event: Every time preparing to run, recalls that slower run
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once there is one bad performance, it will keep getting worse afterward
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Runs less or avoids running to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This run will be terrible too; I might as well not run

special_situations.event: When Reflecting on running performance, only focusing on that poor run, ignoring past successes (like completing the 10K)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only always maintaining perfect performance counts as valuable; any single mistake equals complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive evidence, belittling past successes to maintain self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Past good results do not count; I am just incompetent now

exception_events.target_problem: When running performance recently declined, the client usually develops thoughts of 'I am not good enough / should stop running' while preparing or running, with Reduced drive and considering giving up running.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once after completing a 10K race, Su Kaiwen felt in great shape and proud of herself; training was regular then, diet Good and confident, with no 'should stop running' thoughts, and the running experience was positive.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different approach and situation - more regular training, adequate nutrition; higher confidence, so that run's performance and experience markedly improved.

positive_force: Once trained regularly and successfully completed a 10-kilometer race, showing discipline and endurance
Has a certain amount of social support (several friends to chat about private matters with)
Able to notice positive bodily feelings after running (the body usually feels Good after running)
negative_force: Self-denial and black-and-white thinking, easily equating one off-day with total failure
Overgeneralization and mental filtering, ignoring past successes and focusing only on one poor performance
Work stress and irregular diet lowering training form
Decreased motivation for running and avoidance tendencies

target_behavior.behavior: Decreased motivation for running with 'just stop running' avoidance behaviors and Negative self-evaluation
antecedent: Recalling that poor performance when preparing to run
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing one performance decline, forming the core cognition 'I am not good enough / lost ability', evaluating self in black-and-white terms, causing lowered Self-efficacy and failure Anticipation
target_behavior.function: Avoids feelings of failure and self-shame, avoiding facing possible poor performance again
target_behavior.consequence: Daily physical activity level declines, overall fitness goals and physical and mental health are affected; running training frequency decreases and motivation weakens
